headline: Commission to review a proposed Airport Mission Statement, a proposal for an airport user survey, and updates on PFAS tracking and tree clearing at BVY.
summary: The meeting covers the Airport Manager's report, including budget, noise complaints, and PFAS and tree-clearing updates, plus subcommittee updates on governance and the proposed Airport Mission Statement. Commissioners will also discuss a proposal for an airport user survey and the structure of commission subcommittees.
